# `NET_FIGMA_TOKEN_MISSING`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | error |
| Area | [Network (`NET_`)](README.md#domain-net) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

No Figma token for REST reads.

## What to do

Holotype needs a read-only Figma token. Create one in Figma ▸ Settings ▸ Security ▸ Personal access tokens (scope: File content, read), then run `holotype login --figma`.
